about: One public path per platform method, in both languages. Each contract operation is either wrapped (methods with py and ts paths, the owning handle, arguments and any rename) or unwrapped with a reason. py_args: positional names, then "*", then keywords. ts_args: positional names, then options.<key>. Arguments here are the contract's path and query parameters plus the SDK's own (idempotency_key, wait, timeout, callbacks); each namespace adds its request-body keywords when its methods are written. "internal" names query parameters the wrapper fills itself. scripts/platform/wrapper_map.py and python/tests/platform/test_gates_wrapper_map.py enforce the rules.
